note: Latest KNOWN upstream releases — the reference point for staleness surfacing (Phase 11). Maintained by autobump.yml (CI) or the owner; verified against the public registries named in 'source'. This is a registry, not measurement data: it never changes any verdict, only whether a verified-against version is flagged stale. Consumed by edge-lint (--releases soft warning), the site generator (stale flags), and freshness tooling.
